text:
That is how the face of god must be,

heaven rabidly crossed

by gray, violet

and orange clouds,

and his voice

the sea below

always saying the same thing,

so monotonous,

so monotonous,

like the first

and the last day.

translation.title: That Is How It Must Be
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fierce sky-face and the sea's monotonous divine voice.
